projects.title: Joborg AI
projects.pitch: Turn any job description into a personalized AI mock interview with instant feedback and a readiness report — practice smarter, interview confidently.

projects.title: iCare
projects.pitch: A healthcare management system that turns complex medical documents into plain English. Upload a report, imaging result, or visit note (PDF, JPEG, PNG) and AI returns a clear, actionable summary — key findings, medications, next steps — while your records stay encrypted and private. Built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Gemini AI and Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: CreditHero
projects.pitch: CreditHero turns a confusing credit report into a clear score, a trend line, and plain-English factors you can actually act on. It monitors your report in the background and pushes an alert the moment something changes, so you are never caught off guard — plus tools and resources to steadily improve your score over time.

projects.title: LinguaPath
projects.pitch: An AI-powered language exam prep platform for the Duolingo English Test (DET) and HSK Chinese exams. It offers AI writing assessment, personalized study plans, writing practice with instant feedback, and progress tracking to guide learners toward their certification goals.

projects.title: Data Dungeon
projects.pitch: Data Dungeon teaches SQL through a dungeon RPG: write real queries to clear themed chambers, and an AI Warden (Gemini) mints a verification seal before a clear counts — remove the model and progression stops. Failed queries get Socratic hints, not spoilers, and a stats page tracks pace and weak skills to drill. Six sections, 74 hand-authored chambers, 30 floors — built with Next.js, sql.js, and Neon Postgres.

projects.title: Campus Event Radar
projects.pitch: Stop scrolling ten different club group chats. Campus Event Radar reads every event happening on campus this week and uses AI to hand you the handful that actually match your interests, with a one-line reason why each one made the cut. Add any event you know about and it goes straight into everyone's next digest.
